photos.desc: Puffin ( Fratercula arctica grabae ) on the cliff above The Wick (Y Wig) on Skomer Island, Pembrokeshire, Wales. Approaching its burrow with a mouth full of lesser sand eels ( Ammodytes tobianus )
Puffin ( Fratercula arctica ) above The Wick (Y Wig) on Skomer Island, Pembrokeshire, Wales. Running for its burrow with lesser sand eels ( Ammodytes tobianus ).
Puffin ( Fratercula arctica ) above The Wick (Y Wig) on Skomer Island, Pembrokeshire, Wales. Outside its burrow with lesser sand eels ( Ammodytes tobianus )
Puffin ( Fratercula arctica ) above The Wick (Y Wig) on Skomer Island, Pembrokeshire, Wales. Eating lesser sand eel ( Ammodytes tobianus )
Porposed Marine Protected Areas include measures for vulnerable sandeel populations, which are a key food source for seabirds. Copyright Marine Scotland.
